It uses FirstOrDefault instead, through a new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper for properties. The analyzer's reporting delegate is now wrapped in ReportIfLocatedInCompilation, which passes on a diagnostic only when its location is in source and inside the compilation being analysed. Every other diagnostic is dropped, not reported without a location. Three tests build a defining assembly as metadata only and check that analysis produces no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
